digest.component_or_area: caused_by link event provenance and metrics
propositions: caused_by edges cannot distinguish blame-derived guesses from explicitly supplied attributions, leading metrics consumers to weight them identically
add optional provenance field to caused_by LINK event payload with values derived or explicit, where old unmarked events read as unknown
transition_close._apply_caused_by marks explicit when close carried non-empty --caused-by and derived when culprit came from blame.derive_caused_by
rebar link caused_by path marks attributions explicit since linked attribution is supplied by caller never blame-derived
rebar metrics bug_trends lens gains bug_caused_by_provenance dimension reporting explicit/derived/unknown edge counts to support escape-rate weighting
legacy LINK events without provenance field reduce to dep entries unchanged with no provenance key
